+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { resolve } from 'node:path'
+import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
+
+export function registerSidebarTreeJourneys(test) {
+  test('Sidebar tree remembers folds, keeps current pages visible and flattens Find', async p => {
+    const url = `${pathToFileURL(resolve('harness-board-dist/index.html')).href}?example=sidebar-tree`
+    await p.goto(url)
+    const desk = p.locator('.kbn-desk')
+    for (const id of ['chair', 'hub']) assert.equal(await desk.locator(`.kbn-card[data-fiber-id="${id}"]`).count(), 1, 'working seats stay on Desk')
+    await desk.locator('.kbn-card[data-fiber-id="chair"]').click()
+    const sidebar = p.locator('.ws-sidebar')
+    if (!await sidebar.isVisible()) await p.keyboard.press('Meta+[')
+    const row = id => sidebar.locator(`.ws-channel-row[data-channel-uid="${id}"]`)
+    assert.equal(await row('chair').count(), 1)
+    assert.equal(await row('hub').count(), 1)
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/question').count(), 1)
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/review-2').count(), 0)
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/analysis').count(), 0)
+    const fold = row('chair').getByRole('button', { name: 'Collapse CMB cross-correlations chair', exact: true })
+    await fold.click()
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/question').count(), 0)
+    assert.ok((await row('chair').textContent()).includes('6 need you'))
+    await p.keyboard.press('j')
+    assert.equal(await row('hub').getAttribute('aria-current'), 'true', 'j skips the folded family')
+    await p.keyboard.press('k')
+    assert.equal(await row('chair').getAttribute('aria-current'), 'true')
+    await p.reload()
+    await row('chair').waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/question').count(), 0, 'root fold persists')
+    await row('chair').getByRole('button', { name: 'Expand CMB cross-correlations chair', exact: true }).click()
+    await sidebar.getByRole('button', { name: '+3 more', exact: true }).first().click()
+    await sidebar.getByRole('button', { name: 'Working 2', exact: true }).first().click()
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/review-4').count(), 1)
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/analysis/deep').getAttribute('aria-level'), '3')
+    await p.reload()
+    await row('chair/analysis/deep').waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/review-4').count(), 1, 'more and working folds persist')
+    await row('chair/analysis/deep').click()
+    await row('chair').getByRole('button', { name: 'Collapse CMB cross-correlations chair', exact: true }).click()
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/analysis/deep').getAttribute('aria-current'), 'true', 'current page survives a folded root')
+    const saved = await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('shuttle.sidebar.tree'))
+    await p.keyboard.press('/')
+    await p.locator('input:focus').fill('Response analysis')
+    assert.equal(await row('chair/analysis/deep').count(), 1, 'Find searches intermediate parent names')
+    assert.match(await row('chair/analysis/deep').locator('.ws-sidebar-crumb').textContent(), /CMB cross-correlations chair.*Response analysis/, 'flat Find results retain their full parent context')
+    assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('shuttle.sidebar.tree')), saved, 'revealing Find does not change preferences')
+  }, undefined, 'true')
+}

+import type { KanbanCard } from '../KanbanTypes.js'
+import type { ThreadIndex } from '../threads.js'
+import { cardIdentity } from './SidebarFlight.js'
+import { threadTree, type TreeNode } from './ThreadTree.js'
+
+export type Fold = 'collapsed' | 'more' | 'working'
+export type SidebarFolds = Record<string, Partial<Record<Fold, boolean>>>
+export const SIDEBAR_STORAGE = 'shuttle.sidebar.tree'
+export const rootIdentity = (card: KanbanCard): string => card.uid ?? cardIdentity(card)
+export interface SidebarFamily {
+  root: KanbanCard
+  asks: KanbanCard[]
+  working: Array<{ card: KanbanCard; depth: number }>
+  rows: KanbanCard[]
+  expandable: boolean
+  folded: boolean
+  more: number
+}
+
+/** Optional browser storage; revealing a page never writes a fold preference. */
+export class SidebarPreferences {
+  readonly folds: SidebarFolds
+  private readonly storage: Pick<Storage, 'getItem' | 'setItem'> | null
+  constructor(storage: Pick<Storage, 'getItem' | 'setItem'> | null) {
+    this.storage = storage
+    let folds: SidebarFolds = {}
+    try {
+      const value: unknown = JSON.parse(storage?.getItem(SIDEBAR_STORAGE) ?? '{}')
+      if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
+        for (const [key, row] of Object.entries(value)) {
+          if (!row || typeof row !== 'object' || Array.isArray(row)) continue
+          folds[key] = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(row).filter(([key, value]) => ['collapsed', 'more', 'working'].includes(key) && typeof value === 'boolean'))
+        }
+      }
+    } catch { /* Storage is optional. */ }
+    this.folds = folds
+  }
+  toggle(root: KanbanCard, fold: Fold): void {
+    const key = rootIdentity(root), row = this.folds[key] ??= {}
+    row[fold] = !row[fold]
+    try { this.storage?.setItem(SIDEBAR_STORAGE, JSON.stringify(this.folds)) } catch { /* Storage is optional. */ }
+  }
+}
+
+/** Roots retain Desk order; each expanded family exposes asks before its folded work. */
+export function sidebarOutline(index: ThreadIndex, desk: KanbanCard[], current: KanbanCard | undefined, folds: SidebarFolds, query = ''): SidebarFamily[] {
+  const roots = new Map<string, KanbanCard>()
+  for (const card of [...desk, ...(current ? [current] : [])]) {
+    const root = index.family(index.card(card)).root
+    roots.set(rootIdentity(root), root)
+  }
+  return [...roots.values()].map(root => {
+    const descendants = index.subtree(root)
+    const asks = descendants.filter(card => ['waiting', 'to-review'].includes(index.state(card))).sort(index.compare)
+    const nodes: TreeNode[] = [], pending = [threadTree(index, root)]
+    while (pending.length) {
+      const node = pending.pop()!
+      nodes.push(node)
+      pending.push(...node.children.slice().reverse())
+    }
+    const containsWork = new Set<TreeNode>()
+    for (let n = nodes.length - 1; n >= 0; n--) {
+      const node = nodes[n]
+      if (index.state(node.card) === 'working' || node.children.some(child => containsWork.has(child))) containsWork.add(node)
+    }
+    const working = nodes.filter(node => node.card !== root && containsWork.has(node)).map(({ card, depth }) => ({ card, depth }))
+    const state = folds[rootIdentity(root)] ?? {}, folded = state.collapsed ?? false
+    let rows = [root]
+    if (query) rows.push(...descendants.filter(card => index.state(card) !== 'archived'))
+    else if (!folded) {
+      rows.push(...(state.more ? asks : asks.slice(0, 3)))
+      if (state.working) rows.push(...working.map(row => row.card))
+    }
+    if (current && rootIdentity(index.family(current).root) === rootIdentity(root) && !rows.some(card => cardIdentity(card) === cardIdentity(current))) {
+      const live = index.card(current)
+      rows.push(cardIdentity(live) === cardIdentity(current) ? live : current)
+    }
+    rows = [...new Map(rows.map(card => [cardIdentity(card), card])).values()]
+    return { root, asks, working, rows, folded, expandable: !!(asks.length || working.length), more: Math.max(0, asks.length - 3) }
+  })
+}

story.title: Keep a family’s root visible, and its requests close
story.overview: The Desk keeps a family’s root visible beside its most urgent thread. The reader carries the same family into a persistent sidebar: requests come first, quiet work stays folded, and the page you are reading remains reachable. Two small independent changes complete this snapshot: Pi’s Sol model is selectable, and the cache test locates the running application rather than assuming a build directory.

flags.text: **Check the row-relative counts.** Keeping both root and lead means a count must exclude the row it is printed on, not always the lead. The `others` calculation is where that distinction lives.

chapters.title: Keep the root in sight
chapters.narrative: Start with the shared projection. Each family contributes its root and, when different, its leading request. The count is relative to the row that displays it, so the root and the urgent thread do not silently disagree.
chapters.why_here: The sidebar consumes the same family graph; establish its identities before looking at the presentation.

stops.note: Two rows can represent one family. The root remains an address for the work, while the lead represents the next human decision.
Both rows can carry the family count. Only the lead carries the extra request list.

chapters.title: Make the family walkable
chapters.narrative: The outline is a pure projection of the graph plus the viewer’s fold choices. Three requests are shown before “more”; working descendants retain the ancestors that make their nesting intelligible. A folded family still reveals the currently open page.
chapters.why_here: This is the behavioral core, independent of DOM layout and animation.

stops.note: Read the current-page exception at the end closely: revealing a page must not change a stored fold preference.
The explicit choices are browser-local, keyed by stable root identity. Merely navigating never writes them.

chapters.title: Join the reader to that outline
chapters.narrative: The reader renders fold controls and nested rows from the outline. Workspace placement resolves through the root rather than treating the leading thread as the family’s identity. Tests remain below in their own lane; every other edit stays visible in Remaining.
chapters.why_here: With the projection understood, the rendering and placement glue can be checked against it.

stops.note: Controls preserve keyboard focus after repaint, while filtering exposes descendants regardless of folds.
Placement uses the root when the Desk has it; a lead supplies a caption only when the root is absent.
